g.text: LIPA - MTHFD2 | Alphabetical pages; all687 genes retained. No RNA/association significance filter.
Author broad cell labels. >=20cells per source label/type and >=3labels per type. Gray = missing or insufficient coverage; not zero.
Source labels equally weighted. GSE242230 uses author sample labels. Descriptive expression only; no SC P/q or mechanism inference.
